source: model (campaigns module designer); evidence paths in each entry
grades: M measured, O observed, V vendor-claimed, I inferred, U unknown, P proposed product choice

transitions.when: launch checklist all green (computed on every change)
any checklist item turns red (e.g. agent version unpublished, number lost A2P declaration)

transitions.by: person tap (A2) or API key with campaign.launch scope inside its spend cap
person tap (A2) or scoped API key

transitions.when: start_at reached and checklist still green; else back to ready with the blocker named

transitions.by: person (A2), or engine only when paused_by=provider_outage and auto_resume_after_outage=true and health green 10 min and inside window
transitions.note: guard pauses for opt-out spike, complaint, flagged number or canary never auto-resume

transitions.when: every audience member terminal, or end_at reached (remaining members get reason 'campaign ended')

transitions.effect: no new dials; in-flight calls finish (draining); scheduled follow-ups ask: keep or cancel

transitions.when: recurrence on; parent waits for next run
next run time; a CampaignRun is spawned with its own estimate and period budget

attempt: connected | no_answer | busy | switched_off | not_reachable | invalid_number | carrier_blocked | provider_error | unknown
state_machine.unknown_rule: an attempt whose dial result is not confirmed by the carrier is reconciled against the carrier record for 15 min; still unknown -> state unknown, shown as an issue, never auto-retried (HV law 17)

service.definition: about something the person already bought or a relationship they have (renewal due, EMI due, appointment, onboarding pending); no offer, upsell or cross-sell
service.dnd: not blocked once FULLY BLOCK migrates to BLOCK PROMO about 2026-11-03 (RS-10)
service.consent: relationship basis; no explicit consent needed (RS-03/04/12)
service.series: 1600xx for RBI/SEBI/IRDAI/PFRDA entities; 1601xx utilities and logistics; declared 10-digit otherwise (L1 claims 9-10)

transactional.definition: about a transaction the person just made (order, delivery slot, payment failure)

promotional.consent: explicit; DND numbers need CRF-registered consent (RS-13); inquiry evidence valid 7 days, application 3 months (RS-12)
promotional.row_rule: row held unless consent evidence present and in date and DND status is known-not-registered or consent is CRF-registered
promotional.phase: wave 2 (v2) as a launchable category; v1 holds promotional rows with a reason

windows.timezone: contact local time from a row timezone column; +91 numbers default Asia/Kolkata

holidays.state_holidays: only from a State column in the data; never inferred from the number series (MNP keeps the series: research/2026-10-17/lanes/l5-human-dialect/report.md section (c))
holidays.grade: proposed (product choice; tune on measured campaigns)

windows.cross_midnight: allowed for service and transactional only, set by Compliance role with a reason; daily caps and holidays count on the window's start date; refused for promotional
windows.person_requested_time: honoured inside the outer band and the attempt budget; outside it the agent offers the nearest allowed slot

retries: next day, other half of window

retry_ladder_default_service.agent_action: hang up, no message (voice module default)

retry_ladder_default_service.definition: connected under 10 s, caller ended, no intent captured, no opt-out phrase
retries: next day, other half of window
+5 min recovery call, opener acknowledges the drop
at the stated time if allowed, else nearest allowed slot

retry_ladder_default_service.effect: identifier marked wrong_party for this contact across campaigns
issue raised; CLI health checked; Compliance notified

lending_pre_due.logs: call time and count per borrower exportable

attempt_budgets.grade: proposed (product choice; tune on measured campaigns)

guardrails_pause_if: early hang-up (<10 s) > 50% of first 20 connected
promotion-fence blocks >= 2 on a service call
canary.first_campaign_review_stop: on by default for a workspace's first campaign: stop after 20 calls for a person's review

pacing.jitter: starts spread over the first 10 min of each window opening; no burst at 10:00:00
pacing.reserved_inbound: max(1, 20% of workspace concurrency) whenever an inbound number is bound; 0 otherwise
pacing.carrier_cps: read from the BYO connection; Plivo India limit unknown (U)
pacing.grade: proposed (product choice; tune on measured campaigns)

caller_id.pool_rule: every CLI in the pool matches category x sector series, is A2P-declared, KYC-valid, healthy and carries the same CNAP name
caller_id.rotation_to_evade_flags: never (SquadStack sells 'spam number rotation', research/2026-10-20/teardown/squadstack/claims.json SQS-48; Sarvam rotates 10-digit CLIs, SAR-47)

predial.built_in: always on, not removable: one precheck inside the claim transaction (invariant 1)

formats: XLSX/XLS (sheet picker, Excel date serials, leading apostrophes)
Google Sheets (read-only, one sheet; sync for recurring)
API push (1-1,000 rows per request, external_id idempotency, per-row results)

limits_v1.grade: proposed (product choice; tune on measured campaigns)
limits_v1.benchmarks: Bolna 150,000 rows / 32 MB; Exotel 1,00,000 static / 60 MB; Retell 50 MB; ElevenLabs 25 MB; Vapi 5 MB / 10,000; Sarvam 100 MB

intake.whole_file_refusal_only_if: the file cannot be parsed at all (encrypted, binary, password-protected); the reason and fix are shown
intake.mapping: deterministic header synonyms (English, Hindi, Hinglish: Mobile, Mob No, Contact, phone no, फ़ोन, मोबाइल) first; an LLM only for unresolved columns, given headers and value shapes, never personal values; user confirms with one tap; mapping remembered per source
normaliser: strip spaces, dashes, dots, brackets, quotes, leading apostrophe; convert Devanagari and other Indic digits to ASCII
0 + STD code + subscriber with 10 significant digits -> +91 landline; truncated -> reject LANDLINE_TRUNCATED
extension (x22, ext 22) -> dropped and flagged EXTENSION_DROPPED
bare 10 digits starting 0-5 -> reject; VP never guesses a foreign country and never prepends '+' (stranger guard)
explicit non-+91 country code -> NON_INDIAN, not dialled in an Indian campaign
two numbers in one cell -> hold MULTI_NUMBER (never guess)
toll-free and short codes (1800...) -> reject NOT_PERSONAL
intake.dedupe: within an upload: same E.164 and same normalised record key (policy/loan/customer id; hyphens and case removed), or same E.164 and same transliteration-normalised name (honorifics stripped, case and spacing folded, Devanagari/Tamil to Latin key) when no record key -> one person; near-matches are flagged, never merged; same E.164 and different record key -> separate people on a shared number; conflicts: opt-out wins, first complete valid value wins, all conflicts listed
intake.failed_rows_file: CSV of held, rejected and skipped rows with original values, row code, plain reason, fix, and an empty fixed_value column; re-upload merges by original row id
per_row_overrides: voice (from the agent's approved voice list only)
intake.why_not: per-row prompt or first-message overrides (allowed by ElevenLabs batch, EL-05) bypass compile(), the recitation lint and the reply-door predicates (HV laws 2, 3, 10)

ready_people.R07: Rakesh (N1, shared number, separate slot >= 120 min)
ready_people.R17: Meena (N4, service; BLOCK PROMO does not block service)

suppressed.R09: OPTED_OUT_IN_FILE (N2); R10 and R11 merged into it, OPT_OUT_CONFLICT_OPT_OUT_WINS on R11

messy50_expected.question: 2 rows are promotional offers inside a service renewal list; hold them (default) or start a separate promotional campaign?
messy50_expected.dials: N1 x1 for Sunita, N1 x1 for Rakesh in a later slot, N3 x1, N4 x1; N2 x0

followups.outbox: durable, stable operation id, states confirmed | not_executed | unknown; unknown never auto-retried (HV law 17)
followups.whatsapp: business-initiated utility template needs WhatsApp opt-in; else falls back to the DLT SMS template; no cold marketing templates (L1 claims 22-26)
followups.sms: DLT entity id, header and template id on the rule; template category must match campaign category (wrong-category blacklisting about 2026-12-17/18, RS-06)
followups.links: client's own domain only; no payment on the call (spine P5)
followups.outcome_watch: waits for an outcome event (renewal paid, EMI paid, booking confirmed) until a deadline, then branches (close, or a gentle reminder within budget)

inbound.routing: number -> deployment (agent version or split) with business hours
inbound.after_hours_default: same agent answers; any hand-off becomes a next-business-hours callback and she says so plainly
after_hours_options: same agent, callbacks next business hours (default)
take a message and send an SMS acknowledgement
inbound.caller_lookup: exact E.164 -> 0, 1 or n contacts; shared number -> identity confirmation before account details; an outbound attempt to this person from this CLI in the last 7 days -> callback continuity (continue that campaign's agenda, mark the attempt reached_by_callback, cancel pending retries)
inbound.overflow: queue up to 30 s with a short line, then forward to a human number or promise a callback inside policy
inbound.abuse: more than 10 calls per hour from one caller -> polite end
inbound.grade: proposed (product choice; tune on measured campaigns)

estimate.inputs: eligible people x expected attempts x P(connect) x expected minutes x all-in INR per connected minute + follow-up messages + A2P line
estimate.shown: p10-p90 INR incl. GST and a required cap (default p90 rounded up)
